## Licence {#licence}

[]{.app-badge .app-badge-cc role="img" aria-label="CC BY-NC-SA 4.0"}

The tools and texts of GeoApp are published under the
[Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/deed.en)
licence (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).

You may:

- **share** them: copy and redistribute them in any medium or format, show them in class, embed them in a course page;
- **adapt** them: remix, transform them and build upon them.

On the following conditions:

- **Attribution (BY)**: credit the author (Pascal Burkhard, GeoApp), link to the licence and indicate if you made
  changes;
- **NonCommercial (NC)**: no commercial use;
- **ShareAlike (SA)**: if you adapt a tool or a text, share your version under the same licence.

The licence does **not** cover the data the tools show (UN population estimates, Human Mortality Database, climate
normals, Swiss vote results, maps…): they keep the licence of their source, given under "Sources" on each page.

## Use of generative AI {#ia}

[]{.app-badge .app-badge-ai role="img" aria-label="Made together with generative AI"}

GeoApp carries the label **Made together with generative AI** of the [Me & My Machine](https://mmmlabel.tech/)
system (Fontys University of Applied Sciences): the drops stand for human work, the circuits for AI.

The whole site was made in close collaboration with generative AI: AI produced substantial parts of the tools and
texts, which I reviewed, rewrote and completed. I am responsible for their content.

The other levels of the label are explained on the [GeoDoc page](https://df.geoviews.ch/licence.html#ia).
